title: Flux Kontext joins the image toolbox
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: Flux Kontext arrived, auth got smoother, and another community game made the list.

Flux Kontext support landed in the image service, followed by model-side optimizations and conflict resolution to keep the new path working cleanly. More image-making machinery, because apparently pixels need their own supply chain.

auth.pollinations.ai received UI and UX improvements, making the account flow clearer for people getting set up and returning to their tools.

RETIME - FABRIC OF REALITY was added to the games project list, giving another community-built experiment a place in the public ecosystem.
